label: SC-42(1)
title: Reporting to Authorized Individuals or Roles

statement.prose: Verify that the system is configured so that data or information collected by the {{ insert: param, sc-42.01_odp }} is only reported to authorized individuals or roles.

guidance: In situations where sensors are activated by authorized individuals, it is still possible that the data or information collected by the sensors will be sent to unauthorized entities.

params.label: sensors
guidelines: sensors to be used to collect data or information are defined;
